scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation of exact law, local-limit asymptotic, and triangular-array Gaussian window. Standalone finite checks are corroboration only. External independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-agent independent Bernoulli binary approval model with Like coin-toss allocation. Interior sharp constants are not uniform at the upper boundary. No claims for general online adversaries, more agents, or correlated/nonbinary valuations.
title: Exact PROP1 survival and a Gaussian boundary transition for the two-agent Like rule
